verses.original: δὲ Ἀγρίππας ἔφη πρὸς τὸν Παῦλον σοι Ἐπιτρέπεταί λέγειν ὑπὲρ σεαυτοῦ Τότε ὁ Παῦλος ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἀπελογεῖτο
verses.transliteration: de Agrippas ephē pros ton Paulon soi Epitrepetai legein hyper seautou Tote ho Paulos ekteinas tēn cheira apelogeito
verses.literal: - Agrippa said to - Paul You have permission to speak for yourself Then - Paul stretched out [his] hand [and] began his defense

verses.original: βασιλεῦ Ἀγρίππα ἥγημαι ἐμαυτὸν μακάριον μέλλων ἐπὶ σοῦ σήμερον ἀπολογεῖσθαι Περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐγκαλοῦμαι ὑπὸ Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: basileu Agrippa hēgēmai emauton makarion mellōn epi sou sēmeron apologeisthai Peri pantōn hōn enkaloumai hypo Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: King Agrippa I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today to defend myself against all vvv the accusations of [the] Jews

verses.original: μάλιστα σε ὄντα γνώστην πάντων τῶν κατὰ Ἰουδαίους ἐθῶν τε καὶ ζητημάτων δέομαι διὸ ἀκοῦσαί μου μακροθύμως
verses.transliteration: malista se onta gnōstēn pantōn tōn kata Ioudaious ethōn te kai zētēmatōn deomai dio akousai mou makrothymōs
verses.literal: especially [since] you are acquainted with all the vvv Jewish customs and - controversies I beg [you] therefore to listen to me patiently

verses.original: οὖν μὲν πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἴσασι μου Τὴν βίωσίν γενομένην τὴν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς τὴν ἐκ νεότητος ἐν μου τῷ ἔθνει τε ἔν Ἱεροσολύμοις
verses.transliteration: oun men pantes hoi Ioudaioi isasi mou Tēn biōsin genomenēn tēn ap’ archēs tēn ek neotētos en mou tō ethnei te en Hierosolymois
verses.literal: Surely . . . all the Jews know vvv vvv how I have lived - - from [my] earliest - - childhood among my own . . . people and also in Jerusalem

verses.original: προγινώσκοντές με ἄνωθεν μαρτυρεῖν ἐὰν θέλωσι ὅτι ἔζησα Φαρισαῖος κατὰ τὴν ἀκριβεστάτην αἵρεσιν ἡμετέρας τῆς θρησκείας
verses.transliteration: proginōskontes me anōthen martyrein ean thelōsi hoti ezēsa Pharisaios kata tēn akribestatēn hairesin hēmeteras tēs thrēskeias
verses.literal: They have known me for a long time [and] can testify if they are willing that I lived as a Pharisee adhering to the strictest sect of our - religion

verses.original: Καὶ νῦν ἕστηκα κρινόμενος ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ γενομένης εἰς ἡμῶν τοὺς πατέρας
verses.transliteration: Kai nyn hestēka krinomenos ep’ elpidi tēs epangelias hypo tou Theou genomenēs eis hēmōn tous pateras
verses.literal: And now I stand on trial because of [my] hope in the promise [that] - - God made to our - fathers

verses.original: εἰς ἣν ἡμῶν τὸ δωδεκάφυλον ἐλπίζει καταντῆσαι λατρεῦον ἐν ἐκτενείᾳ ἡμέραν καὶ νύκτα περὶ ἧς ἐλπίδος βασιλεῦ ἐγκαλοῦμαι ὑπὸ Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: eis hēn hēmōn to dōdekaphylon elpizei katantēsai latreuon en ekteneia hēmeran kai nykta peri hēs elpidos basileu enkaloumai hypo Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: [ the promise ] - our - twelve tribes are hoping to see fulfilled as they earnestly serve [ God ] . . . . . . day and night [It is] because of [this] hope O king [that] I am accused by the Jews

verses.original: τί παρ’ ὑμῖν κρίνεται ἄπιστον εἰ ὁ Θεὸς ἐγείρει νεκροὺς
verses.transliteration: ti par’ hymin krinetai apiston ei ho Theos egeirei nekrous
verses.literal: Why {would} - any of you consider it incredible that - God raises [the] dead

verses.original: οὖν μὲν Ἐγὼ ἐμαυτῷ ἔδοξα δεῖν πρᾶξαι πολλὰ ἐναντία πρὸς τὸ ὄνομα Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου
verses.transliteration: oun men Egō emautō edoxa dein praxai polla enantia pros to onoma Iēsou tou Nazōraiou
verses.literal: So then . . . I [too] was convinced that I ought to do all [I could] to oppose - the name of Jesus - of Nazareth

verses.original: καὶ ὃ ἐποίησα ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις λαβών τὴν ἐξουσίαν παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τε ἐγὼ κατέκλεισα πολλούς τῶν ἁγίων ἐν φυλακαῖς τε αὐτῶν ἀναιρουμένων κατήνεγκα ψῆφον
verses.transliteration: kai ho epoiēsa en Hierosolymois labōn tēn exousian para tōn archiereōn kai te egō katekleisa pollous tōn hagiōn en phylakais te autōn anairoumenōn katēnenka psēphon
verses.literal: And [that] is what I did in Jerusalem With - authority from the chief priests - - I put many of the saints in prison and [when] they were condemned to death I cast my vote against [them] . . .

verses.original: πολλάκις αὐτοὺς τιμωρῶν καὶ κατὰ πάσας τὰς συναγωγὰς ἠνάγκαζον βλασφημεῖν τε ἐμμαινόμενος περισσῶς αὐτοῖς καὶ ἕως εἰς ἔξω τὰς πόλεις ἐδίωκον
verses.transliteration: pollakis autous timōrōn kai kata pasas tas synagōgas ēnankazon blasphēmein te emmainomenos perissōs autois kai heōs eis exō tas poleis ediōkon
verses.literal: vvv vvv I frequently had them punished - in - the synagogues [and] I tried to make [them] blaspheme - In my raging fury . . . against them {I} even [went] to foreign - cities to persecute [them]

verses.original: Ἐν οἷς πορευόμενος εἰς τὴν Δαμασκὸν μετ’ ἐξουσίας καὶ ἐπιτροπῆς τῆς τῶν ἀρχιερέων
verses.transliteration: En hois poreuomenos eis tēn Damaskon met’ exousias kai epitropēs tēs tōn archiereōn
verses.literal: In this [pursuit] I was on my way to - Damascus with [the] authority and commission of the chief priests

verses.original: μέσης ἡμέρας βασιλεῦ κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν εἶδον φῶς οὐρανόθεν ὑπὲρ τὴν λαμπρότητα τοῦ ἡλίου περιλάμψαν με καὶ τοὺς πορευομένους σὺν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: mesēs hēmeras basileu kata tēn hodon eidon phōs ouranothen hyper tēn lamprotēta tou hēliou perilampsan me kai tous poreuomenous syn emoi
verses.literal: About noon . . . O king [as I was] on the road I saw a light from heaven . . . - brighter than the sun shining around me and my companions . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: τε ἡμῶν πάντων καταπεσόντων εἰς τὴν γῆν ἤκουσα φωνὴν λέγουσαν πρός με τῇ Ἑβραΐδι διαλέκτῳ Σαοὺλ Σαούλ τί διώκεις με σκληρόν σοι λακτίζειν πρὸς κέντρα
verses.transliteration: te hēmōn pantōn katapesontōn eis tēn gēn ēkousa phōnēn legousan pros me tē Hebraidi dialektō Saoul Saoul ti diōkeis me sklēron soi laktizein pros kentra
verses.literal: - We all fell to the ground [and] I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew . . . Saul Saul why do you persecute Me [It is] hard for you to kick against [the] goads

verses.original: Τίς εἶ Κύριε δὲ Ἐγὼ εἶπα Ἐγώ εἰμι Ἰησοῦς ὃν σὺ διώκεις δὲ Ὁ Κύριος εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Tis ei Kyrie de Egō eipa Egō eimi Iēsous hon sy diōkeis de Ho Kyrios eipen
verses.literal: Who are You Lord - I asked I am Jesus whom you are persecuting - the Lord replied

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀνάστηθι καὶ στῆθι ἐπὶ σου τοὺς πόδας γὰρ ὤφθην σοι εἰς τοῦτο προχειρίσασθαί σε ὑπηρέτην καὶ μάρτυρα τε ὧν εἶδές με τε ὧν ὀφθήσομαί σοι
verses.transliteration: alla anastēthi kai stēthi epi sou tous podas gar ōphthēn soi eis touto procheirisasthai se hypēretēn kai martyra te hōn eides me te hōn ophthēsomai soi
verses.literal: But get up and stand on your - feet For I have appeared to you to vvv appoint you as a servant and as a witness - of what you have seen from Me and what I will show you

verses.original: ἐξαιρούμενός σε ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω σε εἰς οὓς
verses.transliteration: exairoumenos se ek tou laou kai ek tōn ethnōn egō apostellō se eis hous
verses.literal: I will rescue you from [your own] people and from the Gentiles I am sending you to [them]

verses.original: ἀνοῖξαι αὐτῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς καὶ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν τοῦ αὐτοὺς λαβεῖν ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν καὶ κλῆρον ἐν τοῖς ἡγιασμένοις πίστει τῇ εἰς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: anoixai autōn ophthalmous tou epistrepsai apo skotous eis phōs kai tēs exousias tou Satana epi ton Theon tou autous labein aphesin hamartiōn kai klēron en tois hēgiasmenois pistei tē eis eme
verses.literal: to open their eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power - of Satan to - God [that] they may receive forgiveness of sins and [an] inheritance among those sanctified by faith - in Me

verses.original: Ὅθεν βασιλεῦ Ἀγρίππα ἐγενόμην οὐκ ἀπειθὴς τῇ οὐρανίῳ ὀπτασίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hothen basileu Agrippa egenomēn ouk apeithēs tē ouraniō optasia
verses.literal: So then King Agrippa I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τε πρῶτόν τοῖς ἐν Δαμασκῷ καὶ Ἱεροσολύμοις τε πᾶσάν τὴν χώραν τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀπήγγελλον μετανοεῖν καὶ ἐπιστρέφειν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν πράσσοντας ἔργα ἄξια τῆς μετανοίας
verses.transliteration: alla te prōton tois en Damaskō kai Hierosolymois te pasan tēn chōran tēs Ioudaias kai tois ethnesin apēngellon metanoein kai epistrephein epi ton Theon prassontas erga axia tēs metanoias
verses.literal: - - First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem then to everyone in the region - of Judea and then to the Gentiles I declared that they should repent and turn to - God performing deeds worthy [of their] repentance

verses.original: ἕνεκα τούτων Ἰουδαῖοι συλλαβόμενοι με ὄντα ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐπειρῶντο διαχειρίσασθαι
verses.transliteration: heneka toutōn Ioudaioi syllabomenoi me onta en tō hierō epeirōnto diacheirisasthai
verses.literal: For this reason . . . the Jews seized me - in the temple [courts] [and] tried to kill [me]

verses.original: οὖν τυχὼν ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Ἐπικουρίας τῆς ἄχρι ταύτης τῆς ἡμέρας ἕστηκα μαρτυρόμενος μικρῷ καὶ μεγάλῳ τε λέγων οὐδὲν ἐκτὸς ὧν τε οἱ προφῆται καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐλάλησαν μελλόντων γίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: oun tychōn apo tou Theou Epikourias tēs achri tautēs tēs hēmeras hestēka martyromenos mikrō kai megalō te legōn ouden ektos hōn te hoi prophētai kai Mōusēs elalēsan mellontōn ginesthai
verses.literal: [But] I have had vvv vvv God’s help - to this - day [and] I stand [here] to testify to small and great alike I am saying nothing beyond what - the prophets and Moses said would happen

verses.original: εἰ ὁ Χριστός παθητὸς εἰ πρῶτος ἀναστάσεως ἐξ νεκρῶν μέλλει καταγγέλλειν φῶς τε τῷ λαῷ καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: ei ho Christos pathētos ei prōtos anastaseōs ex nekrōn mellei katangellein phōs te tō laō kai tois ethnesin
verses.literal: that the Christ would suffer [and as the] first to rise from [the] dead would proclaim light - to our people and to the Gentiles

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀπολογουμένου ὁ Φῆστος φησιν τῇ μεγάλῃ φωνῇ Μαίνῃ Παῦλε τὰ πολλά γράμματα περιτρέπει σε εἰς μανίαν
verses.transliteration: Tauta de autou apologoumenou ho Phēstos phēsin tē megalē phōnē Mainē Paule ta polla grammata peritrepei se eis manian
verses.literal: At this stage - of [Paul’s] defense - Festus exclaimed - in a loud voice You are insane Paul [Your] great learning is driving you to madness

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Παῦλος φησίν Οὐ μαίνομαι Κράτιστε Φῆστε ἀλλὰ ἀποφθέγγομαι ῥήματα ἀληθείας καὶ σωφροσύνης
verses.transliteration: de Ho Paulos phēsin Ou mainomai Kratiste Phēste alla apophthengomai rhēmata alētheias kai sōphrosynēs
verses.literal: But - Paul answered vvv I am not insane most excellent Festus - I am speaking words of truth and sobriety

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ βασιλεύς ἐπίσταται περὶ τούτων καὶ λαλῶ παρρησιαζόμενος πρὸς ὃν γὰρ οὐ πείθομαι οὐθέν τι τούτων λανθάνειν αὐτὸν γάρ τοῦτο ἐστιν οὐ πεπραγμένον ἐν γωνίᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar ho basileus epistatai peri toutōn kai lalō parrēsiazomenos pros hon gar ou peithomai outhen ti toutōn lanthanein auton gar touto estin ou pepragmenon en gōnia
verses.literal: For the king knows about these [matters] and I can speak freely to [him] vvv vvv I am confident that none . . . of this has escaped his [notice] because [it] was not done in a corner

verses.original: βασιλεῦ Ἀγρίππα πιστεύεις τοῖς προφήταις οἶδα ὅτι πιστεύεις
verses.transliteration: basileu Agrippa pisteueis tois prophētais oida hoti pisteueis
verses.literal: King Agrippa do you believe the prophets I know - you [do]

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἀγρίππας πρὸς τὸν Παῦλον πείθεις με Ἐν ὀλίγῳ ποιῆσαι Χριστιανὸν
verses.transliteration: de Ho Agrippas pros ton Paulon peitheis me En oligō poiēsai Christianon
verses.literal: Then - Agrippa [said] to - Paul Can you persuade me in such a short [time] to become a Christian

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ὀλίγῳ καὶ ἐν μεγάλῳ δὲ Ὁ Παῦλος Εὐξαίμην τῷ Θεῷ ἂν οὐ μόνον σὲ ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντάς μου σήμερον γενέσθαι τοιούτους ὁποῖος ἐγώ καὶ εἰμι παρεκτὸς τούτων τῶν δεσμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai en oligō kai en megalō de Ho Paulos Euxaimēn tō Theō an ou monon se alla kai pantas tous akouontas mou sēmeron genesthai toioutous hopoios egō kai eimi parektos toutōn tōn desmōn
verses.literal: vvv vvv Short [time] [or] vvv long - - Paul [replied] I wish - to God that not only you but - all who hear me this day may become what . . . I - am except for these - chains

verses.original: τε ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ὁ ἡγεμὼν Ἀνέστη τε ἥ Βερνίκη καὶ οἱ συνκαθήμενοι αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: te ho basileus kai ho hēgemōn Anestē te hē Bernikē kai hoi synkathēmenoi autois
verses.literal: Then the king and the governor rose along with - Bernice and those seated with them

verses.original: καὶ ἀναχωρήσαντες ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος πράσσει Οὐδὲν τι ἄξιον θανάτου ἢ δεσμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai anachōrēsantes elaloun pros allēlous legontes hoti houtos ho anthrōpos prassei Ouden ti axion thanatou ē desmōn
verses.literal: - On their way out they said to one another - - This - man has done nothing . . . worthy of death or imprisonment

verses.original: δὲ Ἀγρίππας ἔφη τῷ Φήστῳ οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐδύνατο Ἀπολελύσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐπεκέκλητο Καίσαρα
verses.transliteration: de Agrippas ephē tō Phēstō houtos ho anthrōpos edynato Apolelysthai ei mē epekeklēto Kaisara
verses.literal: And Agrippa said to Festus This - man could have been released if vvv he had not appealed to Caesar
